invariant_hypothesis: I5: Authorization request parameters (scope/claims) must be bound to broker policy; unsigned request objects must not be accepted to expand effective authorization.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Auth endpoint accepted alg=none request object even when signature algorithm was configured; scope/claims can be injected beyond broker policy
Auth endpoint accepted alg=none request object after config weakening; attacker can escalate requested scope/claims without cryptographic binding

description: I5: Token exchange should not allow minting a token for client-B using a subject_token obtained for client-A when audience/azp binding is not satisfied.
invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions/audience of exchanged token must be bounded by the upstream subject_token intent (aud/azp) and broker policy; exchanging a token minted for client-A into client-B should be rejected or yield an inactive token.
